title: The second attacker met the same Maze
era: 2023 Old School using current combat and activated-ability rules
matchup: U/G Control against blue-white flying creature aggression
story: My opponent attacked with Serra Angel and Air Elemental . I had Maze of Ith and Candelabra of Tawnos untapped, with Sol Ring ready. Before combat damage, I tapped Maze targeting the Angel, preventing its combat damage. Then I tapped Sol Ring for two colorless mana and spent one on Candelabra with X equal to one, targeting my tapped Maze. The ability resolved and untapped Maze. I tapped Maze again targeting the Air Elemental. Neither flyer dealt combat damage, while one colorless mana remained floating. Candelabra was tapped now; it had not generated any mana.
review: 2023 Kjostvedt U/G list includes Candelabra, Maze and Sol Ring; flyers are fictional. Two distinct Maze activations made possible by X=1 Candelabra costing one of Sol Ring's two colorless, then untapping Maze. Both attackers remained attacking. Legacy legal claim must use June 29, 2026 ban.
claim: representative reconstruction; not a historical match or quotation
candidateStatus: not accepted; pending ten-article checkpoint and deeper deck research
